inputs.selection: 31 direct upstream dependency archives plus four official mods; A has 35 enabled mods, B adds only the exact MIR candidate; defaults
inputs.copy_policy: One immutable ForceCopy lease per case; fresh process, configuration and write-data per stage; direct-library archives without dependency copies or hardlinks.

collection.restoration: Internal and external before/after library frames equal: four controls, all 18 original MIR archives, 31 direct dependencies, 884 top-level entries, owned inputs and protected original unchanged; Factorio processes absent after completion.

analysis.endpoint: Native printed average update time, milliseconds

confidence95.method: Student-t df5; normal paired-error assumption, six-pair small sample

preserved_adverses.unrun_revisions: r01/r02 pre-execution review refusals and r03 scratch-authority refusal remain preserved; r03 started zero Factorio processes.
preserved_adverses.activity: r04 PID136816 remains callback-interrupted after the engine's work records and Goodbye, without a recorded OS exit code. It is not a native pass or timing sample. The accepted retained reader reconstructs a strictly unscored activity observation; the activity process was not rerun.
preserved_adverses.post_readers: The frozen first reader's settings-loader refusal and the next reader's implicit-core refusal remain preserved. The additive final reader admits the literal settings-loader form and separately binds implicit core@0.0.0, retaining unexpected/contradictory mod rejection and the explicit stdlib2 exception. No raw log, measured metric, input or native execution changed.

limitations: One protected factory, exact Factorio2.0.77 engine, exact e239 source/package and default selection; the accepted endpoint is the printed mean update time only.
No process-to-responsive-menu, MIR4 comparison, 50 percent improvement, retained-memory, spike, Library/client, physical-output or all-modpack acceptance.
All 18 normal observations are retained; the nineteenth adverse activity process is not relabelled as a natural pass.
